_note: Synthetic, normalized Defender CSPM CIEM recommendations for offline demo. No real data. In a live pull these come from Azure Resource Graph (microsoft.security/assessments).

assessments.display_name: Azure overprovisioned identities should have only the necessary permissions
assessments.remediation: Right-size role assignments to the permissions actually used in the last 90 days.

assessments.display_name: Unused identities in your Azure environment should be removed
assessments.remediation: Remove the unused managed identity and its role assignments.

assessments.display_name: Super identities in your Azure environment should be removed
assessments.remediation: Reduce this identity's effective permissions; it can perform nearly all actions in scope.

assessments.display_name: Stale accounts with owner permissions should be removed
assessments.remediation: Remove owner permissions from this stale account.
